event_meanings.main_button_opened: Any main screen tile/header action was opened. Use a button parameter such as cpr, pediatrics, or guidelines.
event_meanings.search_button_opened: The main Search button opened SearchActivity.
event_meanings.stay_connected_button_opened: The main Stay Connected button opened the contact/social dialog.
event_meanings.cpr_button_opened: The main CPR button opened the CPR timer.
event_meanings.waafells_button_opened: The main WAAFELLS button opened the WAAFELLS calculator.
event_meanings.rsi_button_opened: The main RSI button opened the RSI checklist.
event_meanings.ventilator_settings_button_opened: The main Ventilator Settings button opened ventilator settings.
event_meanings.pediatrics_button_opened: The main Pediatrics button opened PediatricsMain.
event_meanings.guidelines_button_opened: The main Guidelines button opened the CPG/SOP/CPM/PAT document viewer.
event_meanings.flowcharts_button_opened: The main Flowcharts button opened the Flowcharts/Formulary screen.
event_meanings.calculators_button_opened: The main Calculators button opened the calculators menu.
event_meanings.visual_guides_button_opened: The main Visual Guides button opened visual guides.
event_meanings.scores_button_opened: The main Scores button opened score calculators.
event_meanings.shift_schedule_button_opened: The main Shift Schedule button opened the team shift calendar.
event_meanings.overtime_button_opened: The main Overtime button opened Overtime.
event_meanings.hos_button_opened: The main HOS button opened HOS.
event_meanings.as_call_button_opened: The main AS-Call button opened AS-Call.
event_meanings.websites_button_opened: The main Websites button opened Websites.
event_meanings.notice_button_opened: The Notice button or notice dialog was opened.
event_meanings.whats_new_button_opened: The Updates or What's New button opened What's New.
event_meanings.notices_bell_button_opened: The user tapped the in-app Notices bell on the main screen to open NoticesActivity. This is different from opening the app from a push notification.
event_meanings.search_query_submitted: A search was performed. Do not log the search text.
event_meanings.search_result_opened: A search result was opened. Log only broad result type if needed.
event_meanings.guidelines_document_loaded: A CPG/SOP/CPM/PAT document loaded in Guidelines. Log document type only.
event_meanings.guidelines_document_tab_selected: A CPG/SOP/CPM/PAT tab was selected. Usually low value.
event_meanings.guidelines_document_search_used: PDF search was used in Guidelines. Do not log the search text.
event_meanings.guidelines_document_reference_opened: A reference action opened a document. Do not log exact page if avoiding detail.
event_meanings.flowcharts_mode_selected: Flowcharts mode was selected in FlowchartsActivity.
event_meanings.formulary_mode_selected: Formulary mode was selected in FlowchartsActivity.
event_meanings.formulary_item_opened: A formulary medication item was opened.
event_meanings.pediatrics_ap_months_opened: AP Months pediatric medication flow opened.
event_meanings.pediatrics_ap_years_opened: AP Years pediatric medication flow opened.
event_meanings.pediatrics_ccp_months_opened: CCP Months pediatric medication flow opened.
event_meanings.pediatrics_ccp_years_opened: CCP Years pediatric medication flow opened.
event_meanings.pediatric_medication_opened: A pediatric medication was selected. If enabled, log medication ID only; do not log age, weight, dose, or concentration.
event_meanings.pediatric_formulary_reference_opened: A pediatric formulary/reference action was opened.
event_meanings.pediatric_normal_vitals_expanded: The compact pediatric normal vitals card was tapped to enlarge.
event_meanings.pediatric_concentration_changed: A medication concentration was changed. Do not log value.
event_meanings.pediatric_invalid_age_or_weight_alert_sh: An out-of-range pediatric age/weight alert appeared.
event_meanings.calculator_calculate_pressed: A calculator calculate action was pressed. Log calculator ID only; do not log inputs or result.
event_meanings.infusion_medication_selected: An infusion medication was selected. Log medication ID only if enabled.
event_meanings.visual_guide_body_area_tapped: A visual-guide body/zone area was tapped. Do not log exact burn zones unless explicitly accepted.
event_meanings.waafells_calculated: A valid WAAFELLS result was produced (auto-calculated on input change). Do not log entered age/weight.
event_meanings.ventilator_condition_selected: A ventilator condition button was selected.
event_meanings.score_qsofa_opened: qSOFA sepsis risk screening score opened.
event_meanings.score_calculate_pressed: A score calculation was used. Do not log selected answers if avoiding detail.
event_meanings.cpr_audio_gender_selected: CPR audio voice gender changed. Log male/female only.
event_meanings.cpr_backup_exported: CPR backup/export was shared or saved. Do not log contents.
event_meanings.cpr_backup_restored: CPR backup restore was completed. Do not log contents.
event_meanings.overtime_record_saved: An overtime record was saved. Do not log salary, hours, date, earnings, or notes.
event_meanings.overtime_backup_exported: Overtime backup/export was shared or saved. Do not log contents.
event_meanings.overtime_backup_restored: Overtime backup restore was completed. Do not log contents.
event_meanings.as_call_contact_selected: An AS-Call contact was selected. Do not log contact name or number.
event_meanings.hos_navigation_started: HOS navigation started. Do not log HOS number or coordinates.
event_meanings.hos_navigation_app_selected: Maps/Waze choice selected. Do not log location.
event_meanings.website_link_opened: A website link was opened. Avoid URL/title; category only if needed.
event_meanings.issue_report_opened: The Report Issue screen opened, regardless of the entry source.
event_meanings.issue_report_sent: Issue report sent. Log method only; do not log description.
event_meanings.remote_helper_loaded: A remote/cache/fallback helper loaded. Log helper name and source only.
event_meanings.remote_helper_failed: A helper failed. Log helper name and reason category only, no URL/host.
event_meanings.app_config_loaded: App config loaded. Log source only.
event_meanings.analytics_config_loaded: Analytics config loaded. Log source only.
event_meanings.admin_panel_opened: Admin Panel opened. Off by default.
event_meanings.admin_config_refreshed: Admin Panel config refresh pressed. Off by default.
event_meanings.stay_connected_email_opened: The Email option in Stay Connected was opened. Do not log message body.
event_meanings.stay_connected_report_issue_opened: The user tapped Report Issue inside the Stay Connected dialog. This tracks the dialog row tap before IssueReportActivity opens.
event_meanings.stay_connected_app_intro_opened: The App Intro option in Stay Connected was opened.
event_meanings.stay_connected_discord_opened: The Discord option in Stay Connected was opened.
event_meanings.stay_connected_telegram_opened: The Telegram option in Stay Connected was opened.
event_meanings.stay_connected_whatsapp_opened: The WhatsApp option in Stay Connected was opened. Do not log phone number or message body.
event_meanings.update_dialog_shown: The app update dialog was shown. Log update type only if needed.
event_meanings.update_download_pressed: The user pressed the update/download action. Do not log full download URL.
event_meanings.push_notification_opened: The user opened the app by tapping an Android push notification. This is different from tapping the in-app Notices bell. Do not log notification title/body.
event_meanings.notices_item_marked_read: An in-app notice item was marked as read. Do not log notice title or body; notice ID only if explicitly accepted.
event_meanings.as_call_call_confirmed: The user confirmed the AS-Call call action and opened the dialer. Do not log contact name or number.
event_meanings.issue_report_method_selected: The user selected an issue report sending method. Log method only, not description text.
